name: Midas Golden Touch Christmas Edition
review:
A snowy version of the 15-line Midas game, with wilds that boost wins, a feature buy and a bonus game where wins stick.

Snow-covered columns and festive music give it its own feel, but the gameplay matches Midas Golden Touch Reborn, including the 96.17% RTP and 10,100x cap. High volatility. A good seasonal pick that doesn't cost you on RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
